notes: lock|Signed calls on your Wi-Fi|Every offer and answer is signed with the channel key, so no one else on the network can slip in.
relay|Straight back after a reload|A browser keeps the Monitor's Wi-Fi address, so a reload or a later visit reaches it right away.
zoom|Zoom where you pinch|Then drag to look into any corner of the room. On a computer, the mouse wheel zooms.
star|A safer End call|The light and dark switch left the call screen, where it sat just above End call.
